correctness.rationale: The trace defining set is reconstructed exactly over \(\mathbb F_8\) and has \(24\) points. The six source-message basis evaluations have binary rank \(6\), and enumeration of all \(64\) messages exactly reproduces the published four-weight enumerator. Every binary message subspace is generated once in reduced-row-echelon form, with the Gaussian-binomial totals \(63,651,1395,651,63,1\). The support of a generated subcode is the union of its basis-codeword supports, so the \(2824\)-subspace census exhausts every code subcode and proves every histogram and minimum stated in the claim.

value.rationale: The primary paper emphasizes projectivity, minimal supports, and applications of the support geometry of this new family. The complete subcode-support distribution is the natural all-dimensional refinement of that support structure: it gives every generalized Hamming weight, every extremal multiplicity, and every nonminimal support layer. For the first concrete [24,6,10] member this is a compact complete structural fingerprint rather than an arbitrary statistic.
